thread:
mike: opened a PR to rollback the traffic-slimming change that looks like it kicked off the latency + 5xx spike in prod earlier. need a quick review/merge so we can stabilize. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821

sre-oncall: confirming — saw p95 jump to ~1.8s and error rate ~2% around 09:15. traces show increased queue wait on prod-api, looks correlated with that rollout. rollback seems reasonable.

anna: can someone confirm we can do an expedited canary (5% -> 100%) after merge? want a short watch window before full rollout.

kevin: CI passed locally for me but one flaky test in staging yesterday — would prefer minimal surface rollback. also pls add a short changelog line.

mike: added changelog and a tiny unit test. included the Kubernetes rollback command in the PR description for oncall ops: 
```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/prod-api --to-revision=42
```
PR also has the minimal diff (revert of the throttling parameter).

deploy-bot: preview build uploaded: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/98765 (status: success)

jess: skimmed the diff — LGTM. one tiny naming nit (non-blocking). :thumbsup:

liam: i'll give final approve once anna confirms canary window. i'm oncall and can watch the rollout.

anna: starting 3-min canary now at 09:42. @sre-oncall pls watch traces and error rate, escalate if anything odd.

sre-oncall: watching traces and logs, will report back in ~3.

kevin: also, can someone add a `rollback_reason` entry to the incident playbook? tiny doc update so we track cause.

mike: done — added a one-liner to the playbook and updated PR. thanks everyone, will merge after liam approves.

jess: merged & triggered canary rollout. keeping eyes on dashboards.

sre-oncall: error rate trending down, p95 back to ~320ms after rollback. looks stable so far. closing loop in incident ticket. (jess reacted :white_check_mark:)

mike: huge thanks — will follow up with postmortem notes tomorrow.
